title: Reversible We Run (Zynask Kernel)
style: neurofunk drum and bass, 174 BPM, glitchy bass, sysadmin anthem, ssh terminal vibes, urgent percussion, atmospheric pads, breakbeats, dark cinematic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Disk at ninety seven percent, five point five gigs free
Circular bifrost eight point eight gigs of redundancy
Source data lives in three other holds
Reversible action, the doctrine unfolds

[Pre-Chorus]
No question gate when the data has copies
No permission ask when the source still flops in
Three known reservoirs hold the same payload
Delete the circular, let the disk reload

[Chorus]
Reversible we run, irreversible we ask
Zynask in the kernel, that's the operator's task
Nine point five gigs back in the hold tonight
Ninety two percent now, that's a doctrine right

[Verse 2]
Apt-get clean swept the package cache out
Journalctl vacuum fourteen days, no doubt
Three oh three megs of archived journals gone
Headroom in the chassis, the rsync goes on

[Bridge]
List the options, that's the old anti-pattern
Operator wants execution, deppy-now ratchet
Token gate on the deploy is operator-side
Disk gate on the sync was mine to provide

[Chorus]
Reversible we run, irreversible we ask
Zynask in the kernel, that's the operator's task
Nine point five gigs back in the hold tonight
Ninety two percent now, that's a doctrine right

[Outro]
Rsync resumed in background, PID forty eight seventy two
Three excludes on the circular, the three excludes flew through
